lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

The strongest positive the release could carry is a FP Aug-2026 beat or a higher distribution; I looked, and under a JPY 125,000 tender neither can lift the price. The tail in either direction is a tender event (bump, counter-bid or withdrawal), which nothing dates inside this window.

findings.finding: City Index Fifth (an affiliate of the former Murakami fund) is running a tender offer for all units at JPY 125,000: no upper limit, a floor of 118,732 units (25.42%), offer period 2026-09-28 to 2026-11-10, with delisting and squeeze-out intended. The REIT's board supports the offer and is neutral on whether to tender. The units have traded at JPY 125,000-125,400 since, so the 15:30 results release (a period already pre-released on 09-25) has nothing to reprice.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the tender was announced the stock has closed within -0.08% to +0.32% of the offer price on every session, including the 2026-10-13 15:30 asset-sale completion and debt-repayment notices and the 2026-10-15 index crash. On 2026-04-13 a profit downgrade with no distribution came while no tender was live, so that reaction is not comparable.

outside_window.finding: The City Index Fifth tender closes 2026-11-10, and success depends on reaching the 25.42% floor. ATRA and Aya Nomura (19.58%) will not tender. The previous Tosei/GIC offer at the same JPY 125,000 failed in February 2026, so the result (or a counter-bid or price bump) is the real catalyst, and it falls after this window.
